drawing_inputs: All inputs necessary for offline redraw are in data/. Original training arrays/model checkpoints are not needed for redraw.
interpretation: Fixed BQIP features; 15,351 genes; 10 held-out folds with five-seed ensembles. Archived correlations are r=0.7276 and rho=0.7495. Feature-combination selection is exploratory; this summary is not strictly nested cross-validation.
